release_rule: A title is opening-ready only when the exact checksum-bound master passes the universal site video and animation contract occurrence by occurrence: content accuracy, narration-or-purpose relevance, image and identity continuity, occlusion, intended animation/motion, complete captions, full decode, an identified human full-title 1x audible watch, the real responsive website player, exact public bytes and discovery/correction propagation. A sampled review, local file, isolated player pass, motion score or successful upload cannot substitute for another gate.

current_public_finding.finding: The public player binds only Episode 04 and binds the older v8 object. The current local candidate binds no motion films. Trailer and Episodes 01-03 are not publicly watchable as motion films, and the Episode 04 object is not the newest or editorially accepted cut.
